opening.argument: The presentation opens by explaining Arbitrum’s layer-two technology and continues with planned technical work, including ZK proving and increased transaction throughput. It also discusses governance and the business model: value generated by the technology goes to the DAO treasury, while block-space margins and a conditional revenue share are discussed in relation to token holders and other chains. Those figures are presented as information about how the ecosystem operates, not as a guaranteed personal return. Nothing in the cited remarks connects them to a required viewer payment, credential submission, or other specific financial action.
